clues.it: Marta era accanto a un'armatura e a nord di Carla.
clues.en: Marta was beside a suit of armor and north of Carla.

clues.it: Anna era nella 9ª colonna e nella 2ª riga, ma non era accanto a uno sgabello.
clues.en: Anna was in the 9th column and in the 2nd row, but was not beside a stool.

clues.it: Elena era accanto a un gargoyle, ma non era accanto a un tappeto.
clues.en: Elena was beside a gargoyle, but was not beside a rug.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 7ª colonna e accanto a un tappeto.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 7th column and beside a rug.

clues.it: Dario era nella 4ª colonna, nella 5ª riga e a ovest di Ugo.
clues.en: Dario was in the 4th column, in the 5th row and west of Ugo.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Vito era a ovest di Elena.
Carla era nella 8ª riga, accanto a una libreria e a ovest di Nino.
clues.en: Carla was in the 8th row, beside a bookcase and west of Nino.

clues.it: Nino era nella 6ª colonna e da solo in Biblioteca, ma non era accanto a uno sgabello né a un calderone.
clues.en: Nino was in the 6th column and alone in the Library, but was not beside a stool nor a cauldron.

general_clues.en: 4 in the west half of the grid.
4 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Anna lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Anna's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 9th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Ugo lascia una sola casella libera: riga 4ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Ugo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 4th, column 7th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Dario lascia una sola casella libera: riga 5ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Dario's own clue leaves a single free square: row 5th, column 4th.

steps.en: Carla's own clue leaves a single free square: row 8th, column 1st.

steps.en: Nino's own clue leaves a single free square: row 9th, column 6th.

steps.it: Anna può stare solo nella 2ª riga: escludendola, a Marta resta una sola casella: riga 1ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Anna can only be in the 2nd row: ruling it out leaves Marta a single square: row 1st, column 2nd.

steps.it: Nino può stare solo nella 6ª colonna: escludendola, a Elena resta una sola casella: riga 3ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Nino can only be in the 6th column: ruling it out leaves Elena a single square: row 3rd, column 5th.

steps.it: Marta può stare solo nella 2ª colonna: escludendola, a Vito resta una sola casella: riga 7ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Marta can only be in the 2nd column: ruling it out leaves Vito a single square: row 7th, column 3rd.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «1 accanto a una botte» non torna senza Sergio: deve stare in riga 6ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: The general clue “1 beside an ale barrel” cannot add up without Sergio: they must be at row 6th, column 8th.
